kind: unified diff from maintained harness to frozen profiler runner

orderedChanges.change: Create a CDP session for the selected page target; enable Profiler and Debugger. Subscribe to Debugger.scriptParsed before navigation.
Set V8 Profiler samplingInterval to 1000 microseconds and start sampling immediately before the existing navigation.

For sampled script IDs, retain scriptParsed URL/hash and passive Debugger.getScriptSource bytes. Link a GWT script only when its bytes exactly match the decoded payload of a loaded cache bundle or its cache URL uniquely identifies that bundle.
Keep the maintained DOM-attribute acceptance loop; stop profiling after the host observes RUNNING:warm. Record stop dispatch/round-trip and possible warm-boundary tail.

Validate sample/time-delta array alignment, loaded bundle identity, unique symbol-map rows, and at least one source-proven mapped GWT sample. Fail the profile capture if a required provenance check fails.
Write the raw V8 profile JSON, compact attribution/provenance JSON, and exact used GWT symbol map compressed with deterministic gzip metadata.
In a separate expected-failure run, send an unsupported Profiler method and require the protocol error; record cleanup and unchanged-input audits.

applicationControl: none; acceptance remains through existing DOM attributes
timingUse: diagnostic ranking only; 1 ms sampling and debugger provenance can perturb timing
rawRuntimeSourcePolicy: Captured in-page GWT JavaScript source is not included; profiler runner source is represented by the patch above.
